start: Owner in Settings on an online gym whose server has busy machines; the switch is off

steps.action: On the card "Busy machines" tap "Open busy machines"
user_sees: Page "Busy machines" / "Tell members when a machine is usually busy"
Button "Back to Settings"
A tick box "Show busy machines to members"
Card "How many of each do you have?" with one box per machine (empty reads "None")
Card "Machines you added"
"Save" greyed with "No changes to save."
must_not: The switch on by default
An endless "Loading…"

steps.action: Tick "Show busy machines to members"
user_sees: The tick; "Save" can be tapped
must_not: Members see anything before Save

steps.action: Use "Find a machine", type 2 in one machine and 1 in another
user_sees: "{n} machines on your list can get busy (you have 1 or 2)." changes as boxes are filled
must_not: A machine with an empty box counted

steps.action: Tap "Save"
user_sees: "Saving…", then a toast "Saved."
"Last saved <day> by <name>."
Under each saved machine a status line
must_not: The toast with nothing saved
The boxes going back to the old numbers
Two saves from one tap

start: Owner on the Busy machines page; the gym has a machine that is not on the ready list

steps.action: Under "Machines you added" tap "Add a machine"
user_sees: Boxes "Machine name" (example "For example: Belt squat") and "How many?" (starts at 1)
"Which exercises are done on it?" with "Find an exercise"
Button "Remove this machine"
must_not: More than 30 added machines allowed (the button greys at 30)

steps.action: Type a name, type part of an exercise name and tap "+ <exercise>"
user_sees: The exercise as a chip "<exercise> ✕"; the find box empties
must_not: The same exercise offered twice
"No exercise with that name." while matches exist

steps.action: Tap "Save"
user_sees: A toast "Saved."; the machine stays under "Machines you added" with a status line
must_not: The added machine saved without its exercises
The machine listed twice

start: Owner on the Busy machines page

steps.action: Type 0, a letter or a huge number in a machine box and tap "Save"
user_sees: An error strip "<machine>: type how many you have, from 1 to {max}, or leave it empty."
must_not: The wrong number saved
A toast "Saved."

steps.action: Add a machine with no name and tap "Save"; then give it the name of a machine already added
user_sees: "Give the machine you added a name."
Then "<name> is on the list twice."
A name over 40 letters: "<start of name>…: keep the name under 40 letters."
must_not: Two machines with one name saved

steps.action: Open the page on a gym that is not online; on a gym whose server lacks busy machines; with the internet off
user_sees: "Busy machines need your gym online" / "Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data)."
"Busy machines are not ready for your gym yet" / "They will appear here once your gym’s server has them."
An error strip and "Try again"
must_not: The editor shown where saving cannot work

start: Owner on the Busy machines page, switched on with machines saved

steps.action: Untick "Show busy machines to members" and tap "Save"
user_sees: A toast "Saved."; the status lines change to the switched-off wording (exact words: unknown)
must_not: Members still shown busy times after the switch is off

steps.action: Tap "Remove this machine" on an added machine and tap "Save"
user_sees: The machine is gone after the save
must_not: The machine removed before Save is tapped and with no way back
Its old busy guesses still shown to members

steps.action: Tick the box again and save
user_sees: Switched on again with the machines kept
must_not: The machine counts lost by switching off and on

steps.action: Change a number, then tap "Back to Settings" without saving
user_sees: The Settings page (the code asks nothing before leaving)
must_not: The unsaved number shown as saved next time

start: Owner on the Busy machines page, switched on

steps.action: Read the line under the switch
user_sees: "{n} members’ phones sent workouts in the last 5 weeks." (a count only)
The line that explains how it works (exact words: unknown)
must_not: A member's name next to a machine
Members' machine use sent from phones while the gym's switch is off

start: Front-desk staff signed in on an online gym; the owner has set up busy machines

steps.action: Open the Busy machines page (address /settings/machines)
user_sees: Page "Busy machines"
Heading "Switched on" or "Switched off"
One line per machine: "<name>: <how many>. <status>"
"Only the owner can change this."
must_not: A tick box, number boxes or a Save button
An endless "Loading…"

steps.action: Look for the card "Busy machines" and tap "Open busy machines"
user_sees: Whether the Settings page shows this card to staff: unknown (Settings page not read); when shown it opens the same read-only page
must_not: A card that opens an editor for staff

start: Front-desk staff on the Busy machines page

steps.action: Try to change a number or the switch
user_sees: Nothing to tap: the page is a plain list with "Only the owner can change this."
must_not: Any change saved from a staff login

steps.action: Open the page with the internet off
user_sees: An error strip and "Try again"
must_not: An old list shown as if it were current
A blank page

start: Front-desk staff on the Busy machines page; the owner switches it off on another device

steps.action: Open the page before the owner has added any machine
user_sees: "Switched off" and "No machines yet."
must_not: An empty page with no words

steps.action: Open the page again after the owner switched it on, then off
user_sees: "Switched on" with the list, later "Switched off"
must_not: "Switched on" still shown after the owner switched it off and the page was reopened
